feeds.title: The Eblin Group Blog
feeds.description: Eblin Group is managed by a Coach, speaker, and author who believes leadership presence requires being present. Follow their blog for articles on Toxic Leaders, leadership qualities, useful tips, management skills, communication skills, general news and updates.

feeds.title: LeaderChat
feeds.description: LeaderChat is a Forum to Discuss Leadership and Management Issues. The Ken Blanchard Companies is the global leader in management training. LeaderChat develop dynamic, human-powered learning experiences that enable leaders at every level to become the ultimate agents of progress and transformation.

feeds.title: How We Lead
feeds.description: HowWeLead.org, created by Ken Blanchard, is a platform designed to inspire positive change. It's a social network where you'll encounter individuals who are deeply passionate about responsible leadership. It's a space where Ken Blanchard steps back from the conversation to listen to your thoughts and opinions. It's a place for celebration, where you can connect with others who share your desire to make a positive impact in the world. It's also a platform where you can highlight and celebrate the leaders who inspire you.

feeds.title: HR Superstars
feeds.description: HR and People Ops can be challenging, but there's a community of others who've been in your shoes. HR Superstars is the podcast from 15Five that connects you with confident and respected strategic people leaders who have conquered a myriad of challenges and now have valuable and actionable insights to share.In each episode, our host, Adam Weber, VP of Community at 15Five, will talk to some of the world's leading innovators in the HR/People Ops space willing to share their insights and advice to help you in your journey...

feeds.title: Breakfast Leadership Blog
feeds.description: The Breakfast Leadership blog offers a comprehensive exploration of leadership principles, organizational strategies, and personal development insights, providing readers with actionable strategies to navigate the complexities of modern leadership. Through engaging articles and thought-provoking discussions, the blog delves into topics such as burnout prevention, workplace culture enhancement, effective communication, strategic planning, and resilience building.

feeds.title: The Leadership Edge Blog
feeds.description: Launched in 1989, The Leadership Edge profoundly impacts the pace, performance, and culture of the most innovative life science companies in the world.The Leadership Edge Blog talks about business skills, management tips, communication skills, leadership information, workplace scenarios, and other leadership-related aspects.

feeds.title: Silicon Valley Leadership Group Blog
feeds.description: The Silicon Valley Leadership Group (SVLG) is California's most dynamic business association representing the innovation economy and its ecosystem. The Silicon Valley Leadership Group Blog features articles on topics such as leadership programs, useful tips, leadership advice, management tips, general news and updates.

feeds.title: UC Davis Leadership Blog
feeds.description: The UC Davis Leadership website is a platform dedicated to the leadership at the University of California, Davis. It provides information about the university's strategic plan, executive recruitments, and messages from the Chancellor. The UC Davis Leadership Blog covers a wide range of topics, from lifelong learning to community education.

feeds.title: California Agricultural Leadership Foundation
feeds.description: The California Agricultural Leadership Foundation is a nonprofit public benefit corporation committed to leadership training and transformational learning experiences in partnership with four California universities. The foundation supports the longest continuously-operating leadership training experience of its kind in the United States. The program is considered to be one of the premier leadership development programs in the world. The foundation also supports alumni learning opportunities and other educational fellowship programs as well as fosters industry partnerships.

feeds.title: Rockwood Leadership Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Rockwood Leadership Institute was founded in 2000 to provide individuals, organizations and networks in the social benefit sector with powerful and effective training in leadership and collaboration.

feeds.title: Leading With Trust
feeds.description: Leading with Trust offers insights on leadership and trust from Randy Conley, Vice President & Trust Practice Leader for The Ken Blanchard Companies. Trust Across America has recognized Randy with a Lifetime Achievement Award as a Top Thought Leader in trustworthy business behavior and he is a founding member of the Alliance of Trustworthy Business Experts. Inc.com named Randy a Top 100 Leadership Speaker & Thinker and American Management Association included him in their Leaders to Watch in 2015 list.
